verdict.rationale: Mercury auto-attaches emailed/uploaded receipts to the correct card transaction and syncs to QuickBooks/Xero with 'AI-powered automations' for coding, but this still requires the user to email or upload the receipt rather than truly automatic capture at the moment of card use. missing for 10: evidence of automatic receipt capture with zero manual upload/email step, evidence of automatic transaction categorization/coding without a bookkeeping sync, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of the receipt-matching accuracy.
